title: Conferpar pilgrimage sign protest over transport policy
organizer: Conferpar pilgrimage; individual priest Alberto Luna and other religious participants reported
threshold_50_evidence: No evidence of >=50 people gathered around the state-policy demand; religious procession is documented but protest eligibility is uncertain.

occurrence.summary: ÚH reports a 16 July pilgrimage stopped near Congress and a displayed transport-reform sign.

organizer.summary: Conferpar pilgrimage; article names priest and other religious participants but does not establish a protest organizer.

demands.summary: Sign called for public-transport reform; group-common demand is unclear.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendance figure reported; the religious pilgrimage itself is not treated as a counted protest.

notes: The police made the priest put aside a sign and threatened detention; the source does not report arrest or wider crowd dispersal.
open_questions: Did at least 50 people jointly participate in a protest rather than a religious pilgrimage? Was the transport-demand banner an organizer-backed demand? What happened after the reported police intervention?

title: Indigenous gathering/camp outside INDI and Avenida Artigas actions
scope: Single observed local action; later Artigas closure may be same or a different episode
organizer: Indigenous families from several communities; named broader national organizer unknown
state_target: INDI and President Santiago Peña; assistance, unmet commitments, land and water
participants_original: La Nación estimates about 750 at INDI on 8 July; other reports describe July14 closure but provide no count.
threshold_50_evidence: Reported ~750 at one Asunción site on 8 July; later report does not quantify.

occurrence.summary: La Nación and ABC report a gathering/road blockage outside INDI on July8; Última Hora reports a renewed Artigas road closure July14.

start_date.summary: La Nación says arrival the prior evening; ÚH says about 15 days before July14 and also since the prior Tuesday. Onset conflicts.

organizer.summary: Communities from several departments; no single cross-site organizer verified.

demands.summary: Assistance and unfulfilled commitments; July14 source adds INDI-head removal, land/basic needs, and request to President.

participants_original.summary: One July8 report estimates ~750; July14 source gives no headcount.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: La Nación reports ~750 at the INDI site on July8, but the same episode boundary/onset is unresolved.

state_response.summary: Traffic diversion is reported; no coercive action against demonstrators in these accounts.

notes: Do not force the conflicting onset narratives into one duration. The candidate preserves the first clearly dated observed gathering and the reported later road closure; whether they are one episode remains open.
open_questions: Were the 750 people on July8 the same communities who blocked Artigas July14? Did the camp begin around June23/24, around July7, or around July8? Was there an intervening end or move?

title: Las Mercedes residents protest insecurity and demand INDI relocation
location: Las Mercedes / General Santos Avenue, Asunción
scope: Neighborhood march and intermittent road closure
organizer: Residents of Las Mercedes; organizer not reported
state_target: President Santiago Peña / national government; public security and relocation of INDI
threshold_50_evidence: No >=50 threshold evidence in the opened report.

occurrence.summary: ABC reports neighborhood residents marched and intermittently closed General Santos Avenue.

demands.summary: Greater security and relocation of INDI.

state_target.summary: President/national state, regarding security and agency siting.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendance number; affected residents are not protest turnout.

notes: ABC mentions separate Indigenous demonstrators and food assistance; those do not belong to this neighborhood candidate.
open_questions: How many residents attended the actual gathering? Was there an official response to this group? When did the action end?
